title: Which Ninja Turtle are you? Free TMNT quiz — cv.cm
description: Free TMNT quiz: answer 12 questions to find out if you're Leonardo, Raphael, Donatello or Michelangelo. Unofficial Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles fan quiz, no sign-up.
lede: The leader, the hothead, the genius or the party dude? Answer 12 questions to find out which Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtle you are.
about: The Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles began in 1984 as a comic by Kevin Eastman and Peter Laird and grew into cartoons, films, toys and games loved by several generations. Four turtle brothers, named after Renaissance artists and trained in ninjutsu by their rat sensei Splinter, live in the sewers of New York and fight crime between slices of pizza. Each has his own color, weapon and personality: Leonardo, the blue-masked leader with two swords; Raphael, the red-masked hothead with sai; Donatello, the purple-masked inventor with a bo staff; and Michelangelo, the orange-masked joker with nunchucks.

Your result names your turtle and shows your scores for all four. Every question offers each turtle once, so each result is equally likely. This is an unofficial fan quiz written for cv.cm. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the creators, Paramount or Nickelodeon; the names belong to their owners.

faq.q: Is one result rarer than the others?
faq.a: Every turtle appears in the same number of answers, so each one is equally likely.

leonardo.name: Leonardo
leonardo.body: You're the leader: disciplined, responsible and calm under pressure. You keep the team together, you think before you act and you hold yourself to high standards. People look to you when things go wrong. Remember you don't have to carry everything alone; your brothers have your back.

raphael.name: Raphael
raphael.body: You're the tough one: bold, passionate and fiercely loyal. You say what you think, you're first into a fight and you'd do anything for the people you love. Your temper can flare, but underneath is a big heart. Count to ten now and then, and keep that fire for what matters.

donatello.name: Donatello
donatello.body: You're the brains: curious, inventive and always tinkering. You'd rather solve a problem than punch it, and you can build almost anything from spare parts. You're calm, patient and smarter than you let on. Come out of the lab once in a while; the team needs you there too.

michelangelo.name: Michelangelo
michelangelo.body: You're the heart of the team: fun, friendly and full of energy. You lighten the mood, you make friends anywhere and you see the bright side of everything. People underestimate you, but you're more skilled and more caring than they think. Cowabunga!
